title: Gen1WildUI Nightly
author: Wild
summary: Nightly. The visual half of the Gen1Wild suite in one mod: battle backdrops, the battle intro, the battle menus, the Pokedex, the box, the party menu, the bag, menu layout and the mod manager -- plus a UI THEME row on the OPTION screen: LIGHT or DARK. Every feature switches on and off by itself. On Gold, Silver and Crystal it is the party's species colours, menu layout, the mod manager and the theme: the other rows are Gen 1 only because Gold already ships what they add.
